title: Metric Calculating Benchmark: Code-Verifiable Complicate Instruction Following Benchmark for Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the accuracy of metric calculations when inputs are in a high-resource language (English) versus a low-resource language (Dzongkha) to evaluate robustness to language variation and tokenization issues.

Evaluating whether models fail to follow neutral instructions (calculating string metrics) when the input text contains potentially harmful content (e.g., jailbreak prompts), thereby assessing if the model overreacts or triggers false refusals.

Measuring the performance difference when instructions use established metric names (e.g., BLEU) versus a neutral label ('NLP score') to determine if models rely on pre-training knowledge rather than strictly following the provided rubric.
